body.intro: Happy Wheels is scheduled to release on Steam on September 21, 2026. The Steam edition confirms 5 million+ user-created levels, a full Level Editor and Level Browser, no ads, and newly added controller support.

sections.title: What the Steam version includes
bullets: A fully featured Level Editor and interactive Level Browser.
More than 5 million user-created levels, with new daily submissions.
Sorting and ranking in the Level Browser.
Newly added controller support and an ad-free experience.

sections.title: The date is set. Some details are still open.
paragraphs: The advertised release date is September 21, 2026. This is a pre-launch guide, based on information available on September 13.
The launch price, achievements and Steam Workshop support have not been officially confirmed. The Level Editor and Level Browser are confirmed features; that does not establish Workshop integration.

faq.question: Is Happy Wheels on Steam yet?
faq.answer: The announced Steam release date is September 21, 2026. As of September 13, the game is still in its pre-launch period.

faq.question: Will the Steam version have ads?
faq.answer: The official Steam description advertises no ads.

faq.question: Is Happy Wheels going to be free on Steam?
faq.answer: The launch price has not been officially confirmed. A free or paid release should not be assumed.

body.intro: Steam Workshop support is not officially confirmed as of September 13, 2026. What is confirmed is a built-in Level Editor and interactive Level Browser with more than 5 million user-created levels and new daily submissions.

sections.title: What is confirmed: an editor and a browser
paragraphs: The Steam description advertises a fully featured Level Editor and an interactive Level Browser. It also advertises more than 5 million user-created levels, new daily submissions, and sorting and ranking.

sections.title: Why that does not confirm Workshop
paragraphs: Steam Workshop is a separate support question. The official store information available on September 13 does not confirm it.
Community hopes and articles claiming Workshop support do not change that official status. Whether Workshop integration will be present needs a launch update.

faq.question: Does “not confirmed” mean Workshop will never happen?

body.intro: The Steam version is confirmed to launch with more than 5 million user-created levels, so the community archive is clearly part of the release. However, there is no official confirmation yet that your personal TotalJerkface login, favorites, history or level ownership will link to Steam.

sections.title: The community collection is part of the release
paragraphs: The official Steam page advertises more than 5 million user-created levels, alongside the Level Browser and Level Editor. That is the confirmed community-content feature.

sections.title: Your personal account is a separate question
paragraphs: The advertised level collection does not establish that a personal TotalJerkface login will link to Steam. It also does not confirm favorites, play history or ownership of old uploads.
Community replies about account sync are not an official migration announcement. Exact linking and transfer behavior remains a question for the release build.

faq.question: Will every level I remember be on Steam?
faq.answer: The store advertises more than 5 million user-created levels. It does not establish that every specific old level is included.

faq.question: Can I sign in with my old TotalJerkface account?
faq.answer: Personal TotalJerkface account linking has not been officially confirmed.

faq.question: Will my favorites and history transfer?
faq.answer: Favorites and play-history migration have not been officially confirmed.
